opennyai_summary.decision:
The appellant - Universal Sompo General Insurance Co. Ltd. is in appeal under section 173 of Motor Vehicles Act, Svt., 1988 against an award dated 16.06.2023 passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (MACT), Rajouri on File no. 31/Claims whereby injury compensation has been granted in favour of the respondent no. 1 - Gurbaksh Singh and the challenge to the impugned award is on the ground of quantum of compensation granted.
02. Issue notice to the respondent no. 1 - Gurbaksh Singh only as the respondents no. 2 and 3 as being driver and owner of the offending vehicle, are not to be served.
03.
Petitioner to furnish registered postal cover for the service of respondent no. 1 - Gurbaksh Singh within a period of 7 days, whereupon the Registrar Judicial, Jammu to issue notice to the respondent no. 1 - Gurbaksh Singh.
The Registrar Judicial, Jammu shall be entitled to extend time for furnishing of registered postal covers if not submitted within time given.
04. List on 10.11.2023.
In the meantime, the appellant - Universal Sompo General Insurance Co. Ltd. is directed to deposit the award amount along with updated interest part with this Court within a period of eight (8) weeks, upon deposit of which the same to be kept in fixed deposit for initial period of six (6)
months subject to further orders/removal.
